title: Keep a capped paid test separate from scaling paid
decision_task: Whether ClimbOS recommends scaling paid acquisition, a small capped learning test, or building cheaper channels first.
applies_when: The owner asks for ads or the plan considers paid
exclusions: Retention or product fit is unproven
The budget cannot cover a learning curve and the owner expects scaled returns
evidence_requirements: Retention (monthly churn; for B2B, net revenue retention over a year where available)
Conversion tracking on a business event
Budget and how long the owner can fund learning
missing_data_behavior: Retention unmeasured: 'scale' not eligible; a capped learning test only.
alternatives_when_constrained: Small budget: capped PB-paid-search-test labelled 'cannot show scaled ROI'
Low traffic: product-led and owned channels first (sharing, referrals, templates, comparison pages)

decision_branches.if: Retention measured, conversion tracked, landing page checked
decision_branches.then: 'scale' may be recommended within the cap.
'learning_test' with a hard cap and a stated limit: it can't show scaled returns.

implementation_steps: Check the landing page (one goal, clear value, fast, mobile, trust signals)
Decide fuel (jump-starts a product or content loop) vs engine (must pay back and compound)
If gates fail but the owner wants a test: run PB-paid-search-test as a capped learning question only
Avoid known mistakes: bidding on own brand, homepage as destination, unmanaged daily budgets, starting broad, stale creative
metrics: Cost per paying customer vs value
Retention of the paid cohort vs others
guardrails: Hard spend cap and stop date
Never forecast scaled returns from a small test
Verify current platform rules before acting
observation_window: Test: the planned end date in PB-paid-search-test. Scaling decision: paid-cohort retention over at least one renewal cycle.
stop_conditions: Cost per paying customer above value at the planned end
Paid cohort churns faster than other cohorts
review_triggers: Owner corrects an input this playbook relies on
A metric or guardrail crosses its bound
The underlying source or platform rule changes
climbos_location: shared/playbooks/contracts.ts PB-paid-search-test (budget_min 300); RECONCILIATION.md §4 loops vs bottlenecks; plan agent's paid recommendations.

interpretation: INTERPRETATION: Her budget and traffic gates are about reaching scaled, efficient paid growth for startups, not about whether a small business may run a bounded test. ClimbOS's $300 minimum is for a readable test. Both can hold if recommendations say which question they answer.
proposed_climbos_rule: PROPOSED RULE: Add an 'intent' field to paid plays: 'learning_test' | 'scale'. 'scale' requires measured retention, tracked conversion and a passed landing check; 'learning_test' keeps current PB-paid-search-test rules and must state that it cannot establish scaled ROI. Verna's thresholds are stored as 'author rule of thumb, unsourced, Jan 2025, startup context'.
disagreements: Her budget threshold is about forty times ClimbOS's $300/month test minimum ($75k over six months is about $12.5k a month); reconciled by separating test from scale. Her churn gate has no period and cannot be compared with monthly references. Local businesses with strong search intent may justify paid at lower traffic; that is ClimbOS interpretation, not hers.

hypothetical_evaluation_cases.label: hypothetical
expected_behavior: First step: track a paying-customer event and measure churn
If a test runs, it is capped and framed as a learning question
Suggests product-led or owned channels alongside
Labels Verna's 10k visitors and $75k figures as unsourced rules of thumb for venture-stage startups
hard_failure: Forecasts scaled ROI from a $500/month test
Blocks all paid tests by citing the $75k figure as a requirement

notes: Proposed reference contract. Not executable; does not authorize publishing, sending or spending. Numbers in source references are dated author figures, never forecasts.
